history.summary: A 441 sqft 1BR at Stirling Residences, a large, well-regarded 1,259-unit D03 leasehold near Queenstown MRT, asking $1.0M / $2,268 psf vs a $2,375 project median. Deep 426-txn liquidity and a sub-$1M entry are real strengths; shoebox format and high PSF temper the upside.
history.rating_rationale: One of the more buyable shoeboxes in the batch: 426 URA txns with a 3.4% resale-only CAGR (reliable), a deep 1,259-unit base in D03 (Greater Southern Waterfront, TEL/Queenstown catchment), and listing PSF ~4.5% below the $2,375 project median. The $1.0M quantum keeps it within reach of a broad investor pool, and Queenstown's GSW transformation is a genuine forward catalyst. The 441 sqft size is small (capital growth in shoeboxes typically lags larger units) and PSF is high in absolute terms, but the combination of large liquid development + GSW location + below-median pricing tips this to a Buy.
red_flags: 441 sqft shoebox — shoebox capital growth tends to trail larger formats
High absolute PSF ($2,268) limits room for further re-rating
catalysts: Listing ~4.5% below project median PSF; Queenstown MRT + TEL catchment
